Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequest,
		selectedTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstances()->any(t: LoanTerm|t.ItemID = termid)
	precondition:
		currentRequest<>null and
		self.CurrentLoanRequests->includes(currentRequest) and
		LoanTerm.allInstances()->exists(t: LoanTerm|t.ItemID = termid)
	postcondition:
		currentRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(selectedTerm) and
		result = true
}
